items.title: Steam Momos (Veg)
items.description: Authentic Tibetan-style steamed dumplings stuffed with finely minced fresh garden vegetables and mild herbs. Served with spicy red chutney.

items.title: Steam Momos (Paneer)
items.description: Piping hot steamed dumplings stuffed with soft grated cottage cheese, green chillies, and delicate Himalayan spices.

items.title: Steam Momos (Chicken)
items.description: Steamed dumplings stuffed with tender minced chicken, scallions, garlic, and freshly cracked black pepper.

items.title: Fry Momos (Veg / Paneer / Chicken)
items.description: Crispy golden deep-fried momos with a crunchy outer layer and savory filling inside. Served with mayo and hot chutney.

items.title: Tandoori Momos
items.description: Tossed in spicy yogurt tandoori marinade, roasted over charcoal, and sprinkled with chaat masala and fresh coriander.

items.title: Special Tandoori Masala Momos
items.description: Chef's special double-spiced tandoori masala momos charred in clay oven with butter and tangy onions.

items.title: Kurkure Momos
items.description: Coated in crunchy cornflake batter and deep-fried to create an irresistible extra crunchy texture.

items.title: Cheese Chilli Momos
items.description: Spicy chilli garlic momos smothered in melted cheese and garnished with sliced capsicum and green chillies.

items.title: Special Cheese Momos
items.description: Loaded with rich processed and mozzarella cheese filling that melts in your mouth.

items.title: Afghani Malai Momos
items.description: Momos drenched in rich cashew malai cream sauce, butter, herbs, and delicate white pepper.

items.title: Pizza Momos
items.description: Fusion favorite! Baked momos topped with rich pizza sauce, sweet corn, oregano, and gooey melted mozzarella.

items.title: Plain French Fries
items.description: Crispy golden deep-fried potato fries salted to perfection.
